// The scheduler is cooperative and only changes coroutine at an await,
// so a method with no await in it runs to completion undisturbed.

use default
use Ghul.Coroutines

class BUCKETS is
    _values: LIST[int]

    init(values: int[]) is
        _values = LIST(values)
    si

    count: int => _values.count

    values: List[int] => _values

    total: int => _values |> reduce(0, (running, v) => running + v)

    get(index: int) -> int => _values[index]

    transfer(from: int, to: int, amount: int) is
        let moved =
            if amount < 0 then 0
            elif amount > _values[from] then _values[from]
            else amount
            fi

        _values[from] = _values[from] - moved
        _values[to] = _values[to] + moved
    si
si

let random = System.Random(42)
let buckets = BUCKETS([10, 20, 30, 40, 50])
let rounds = 6

pick() -> int => random.next(0, buckets.count)

equalise() -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::rounds do
        let a = pick()
        let b = pick()

        let (larger, smaller) =
            if buckets.get(a) > buckets.get(b) then (a, b) else (b, a) fi

        buckets.transfer(
            larger, smaller,
            (buckets.get(larger) - buckets.get(smaller)) / 2)

        await pause()
    od
si

redistribute() -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::rounds do
        buckets.transfer(pick(), pick(), random.next(0, 60))

        await pause()
    od
si

display() -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::rounds do
        let shown = buckets.values |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" ")

        write_line("{shown}  total {buckets.total}")

        await pause()
    od
si

equalise()
redistribute()
display()

run()
